data_path_loss_points.detail: Stores question_archetype in constraints and mentions Archetype in objective description; does not set visual_required / diagram_spec fields.
JSON shape has no diagram_svg/diagram_description. build_user_prompt never reads constraints.question_archetype as a hard visual requirement.
Model follows neet_mcq_factory_v1 schema → text MCQ only.
No check that diagram archetypes include a visual.
QuestionBody has no diagram_svg/diagram_description; extra keys ignored. Separate DiagramBody exists for content_type DIAGRAM only, unused by factory MCQ path.
Factory generation path does not write ingestion VisualAsset or diagram specs for MCQs.

finding_2_zoology_12.note: Not an isolated one-off: all 3 planned diagram slots lack visuals. This sampled item is the visible P5 instance of the systemic gap.

options.text: The pulmonary circuit operates at a lower vascular resistance and pressure, receiving deoxygenated blood from the right ventricle, whereas the systemic circuit operates under higher pressure to pump oxygenated blood from the left ventricle to body tissues.
options.label: A

options.text: The pulmonary circuit receives deoxygenated blood from the left atrium and routes it through the pulmonary veins to the lungs, whereas the systemic circuit receives oxygenated blood from the right atrium and routes it through the aorta.
options.label: B

options.text: The pulmonary circuit operates under higher vascular resistance than the systemic circuit, ensuring rapid blood flow through capillaries, while the systemic circuit operates at low resistance to protect delicate organ beds.
options.label: C

options.text: The pulmonary circuit begins in the right ventricle and terminates at the left atrium carrying oxygenated blood, whereas the systemic circuit begins in the left ventricle and returns deoxygenated blood to the right atrium.
options.label: D

dual_correct_analysis.A: Correct: pulmonary lower pressure/resistance from RV; systemic higher pressure from LV — scientifically sound.
dual_correct_analysis.D: Also defensible: pulmonary RV→LA; systemic LV→RA with oxygenation states — anatomically/physiologically sound.

validation_behavior.gap_detail: Validates schema shape and answer↔explanation letter consistency only; does not detect multiple scientifically defensible options.

finding_3_zoology_15.classification_detail: ISOLATED_CONTENT_DEFECT (this stem/options) + VALIDATION_GAP (no semantic single-answer check).

mechanism: Each V2 blueprint is unique → each item is its own stratum bucket of size 1.
Round-robin over sorted strata keys therefore equals taking the first N keys in lexicographic order.
academic.subjects.id UUID order: Zoology (1bbd…), Chemistry (3325…), Physics (8546…), Botany (9228…).
First 20 sorted keys fall entirely in Zoology then Chemistry — reproducing the observed skew.
finding_4_sampling.recommendation: Introduce a separate V2 sampling policy (e.g. factory_sample_v2_seed) that enforces minimum subject / difficulty / graphical / numerical representation without mutating factory_sample_v1 behavior for other populations.

finding_5_representativeness.rule: Do not extrapolate sample ACCEPT rate to full 100. Graphical 0/100 is population evidence, not sample-only.

tests.note: Read-only reproduction; no production behavior changed.

A_visual_blueprint_enforcement.action: Add constraints.visual_required / visual_spec for diagram archetypes; fail blueprint eligibility if missing.

B_visual_asset_or_spec_generation.action: Extend factory prompt+schema to emit diagram_svg or structured diagram_spec; or attach VisualAsset. Do not claim NCERT figure reproduction.

C_visual_validation_gate.action: P3/P4 reject diagram archetypes lacking visual fields; Gate for stem↔visual consistency.

D_exactly_one_answer_validation.action: Add stronger distractor/ambiguity checks where feasible; at minimum flag CORRECTION_REQUIRED path. Full semantic judge optional later — do not pretend NLP solves all dual-correct cases in P3.

E_v2_representative_sampling.action: New policy factory_sample_v2_seed with subject/difficulty/graphical/numerical minima; leave factory_sample_v1 unchanged.

F_semantic_diversity_detection.action: Separate Diversity Forensics gate after remediation A–E; not a substitute for visual/answer fixes.

minimum_remediation_plan.before_large_scale_generation: A+B+C mandatory; D+E strongly recommended; F as next gate after fixes.

diversity_forensics.reason: Remediate visual pipeline + dual-answer handling + V2 sampler first; otherwise diversity forensic would certify a text-only cohort against a plan that intended visuals.
